item.title: Lee Hwa-young Guilty of Perjury in ‘Salmon Drinking Party’ Case… People Power Party: “Mass Deception of the Public Revealed” vs. Democratic Party: “Misleading Public Opinion” (이화영 ‘연어 술파티 위증’ 유죄…국힘 “대국민 사기극 드러나” 민주 “여론 호도”)
item.description:
On the 20th, the ruling and opposition parties engaged in sharp exchanges over the first-instance verdict in a citizen-participatory trial, where Lee Hwa-young, former Vice Governor of Gyeonggi Province, was sentenced to four months in prison for perjury. Lee had been indicted for raising allegations about the so-called “salmon drinking party.” <<> On the same day, the People Power Party (PPP) stated, “The frame of the ‘fabricated investigation’ by the giant opposition party and President Lee Jae-myung has now been clearly exposed as a mass deception of the public.” Senior spokesperson Park Sung-hoon said in a commentary, “The former Vice Governor’s absurd lies were the key script for the Democratic Party to portray the entire Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case as a ‘prosecutorial fabrication.’ The true nature of the ‘salmon drinking party in the prosecution office’ allegations, which deceived the public and ridiculed the judiciary, has finally been revealed.” <<> Senior spokesperson Park pointed out, “The Democratic Party clung to this false claim as if it were a family heirloom, holding hearings and parliamentary investigations in the National Assembly, and even raged about impeaching prosecutors who conducted legitimate investigations. Moreover, they pushed for a ‘special counsel for indictment withdrawal’ to erase President Lee’s legal risks.” <<> In response, the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) countered, “With the specific details of the verdict not yet fully released, clinging solely to the perjury charge and talking about a mass deception of the public is a clear attempt to mislead public opinion.” <<> National Assembly floor spokesperson Lee Joo-hee said in a commentary, “The essence of this ruling is that all major charges except perjury were acquitted or dismissed. The court’s judgment that the prosecution indicted the defendant as an accomplice without evidence, violating his right to defense, proves that the allegations of illegal investigation and fabricated testimony revealed by the Democratic Party during past parliamentary inquiries were largely acknowledged.” She added, “The unprecedented 184 appearances of former Chairman Kim Sung-tae, who is detained, before the prosecution, and the ‘testimony seminars’ during that process, have exposed the despicable face of political manipulation through the judicial verdict of dismissal of charges.” <<> Furthermore, she stated, “Even the perjury charge that resulted in a conviction was decided by a 4-to-3 jury vote, extremely split. The former Vice Governor has consistently testified to the factual existence of the drinking party, and as a lie detector test showed a truthful response, it is difficult to conclude it was intentional perjury.” She emphasized, “The verdict is not yet final, and we need to closely examine the specific reasons in the appeals process.” <<> Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (20일 이른바 ‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹을 제기해 위증 혐의로 기소된 이화영 전 경기도 부지사가 국민참여재판 1심에서 징역 4개월의 실형을 선고받은 것을 두고, 여야는 날선 공방을 벌였다. )

item.title: Na Kyung-won: "After Shaking the Nation with the Fabricated 'Salmon Drinking Party'... 'Build-Up' for Indictment Cancellation Fails" (나경원 “날조된 ‘연어 술파티’에 나라 흔들더니…공소취소 ‘빌드업’ 실패”)
item.description:
Following the judiciary's ruling that former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace, Lee Hwa-young, gave false testimony before the National Assembly regarding the so-called "salmon drinking party," the People Power Party ramped up pressure on President Lee Jae-myung and the ruling bloc, urging them to "abandon their obsession with canceling the indictment in the North Korean remittance case." <<> People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik wrote on Facebook on the 20th, "The core basis for the Democratic Party's claims that President Lee’s indictment in the North Korean remittance case should be dropped has collapsed. President Lee Jae-myung must now give up his obsession with canceling the indictment." After Lee Hwa-young was sentenced to four months in prison for violating the National Assembly Testimony and Appraisal Act at the Suwon District Court on the same day, the assertion that the prosecution had engaged in a "fabricated investigation and indictment" was proven false, meaning the ruling bloc's efforts—such as granting a special prosecutor the authority to withdraw the indictment—based on these claims should also be retracted. <<> The prosecution indicted then-Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung on charges of third-party bribery, alleging that Gyeonggi Province had the Ssangbangwool Group pay money owed to North Korea on its behalf, relying on the testimony of former Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young. However, Lee Hwa-young later claimed that the prosecution had bribed him with salmon and soju and pressured him into giving false testimony, which he reiterated during his National Assembly testimony. This became the basis for the Democratic Party's push for a "special law on fabricated indictments" to investigate whether the prosecution had engaged in a "rigged" investigation against President Lee, and for including provisions granting a special prosecutor the authority—normally reserved for prosecutors—to cancel the indictment. <<> Na Kyung-won, a People Power Party lawmaker, also posted on Facebook: "The Democratic Party mobilized all its party resources over the fabricated salmon drinking party, shaking the entire nation for over two years and turning the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and the National Assembly into a mess," adding, "In the end, their build-up for canceling the indictment and their false fabrication show ended in failure." <<> By Choi Won-hyung, Staff Reporter circle@hani.co.kr (이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사의 이른바 ‘연어 술파티’ 국회 증언이 허위였다는 사법부의 판단이 나오자, 국민의힘 쪽은 “대북송금 재판의 공소취소에 대한 집착을 포기하라”며 이재명 대통령과 여권 쪽을 압박하고 나섰다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk Donates 1 Million Won to Roh Moo-hyun Foundation… Following Yoo Si-min’s Plea to "Take Good Care of It" (조국, 노무현재단에 100만원 후원…“잘 지켜달라” 유시민 당부 뒤)
item.description:
Former Representative Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party announced on the 20th that he donated 1 million won to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation. (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 노무현재단에 100만원을 후원했다고 20일 밝혔다.)

Cho revealed the donation via Facebook that day, stating, "I made a one-time donation to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation." (조 전 대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “노무현재단에 ‘일시후원’을 했다”며 후원 내용을 공개했다.)

He explained, "The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation was established after Moon Jae-in, Han Myeong-sook, and Yoo Si-min announced plans for its creation at the 49th-day memorial ceremony for President Roh on July 10, 2009. It has since been led by successive chairpersons, starting with Han Myeong-sook, followed by Moon Jae-in, Lee Byung-wan, Lee Hae-chan, Yoo Si-min, Jeong Sye-kyun, and Cha Seong-su." (그는 “노무현재단은 2009년 7월 10일 노 대통령 49재 안장식에서 문재인, 한명숙, 유시민 등이 설립계획을 발표한 후 설립돼 초대 한명숙을 거쳐 문재인, 이병완, 이해찬, 유시민, 정세균, 차성수 등이 차례로 이사장을 맡았다”고 소개했다.)

Cho’s donation recalls writer Yoo Si-min’s plea. Yoo stepped down from his position as executive director of the foundation on the 15th after Roh’s son-in-law, Gwak Sang-eon, a Democratic Party lawmaker, directly criticized him, saying, "I’m not sure who the foundation is actually promoting." (조 전 대표의 후원은 유시민 작가의 당부를 떠올리게 한다. 유 작가는 노 전 대통령 사위 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원이 ‘재단이 실질적으로 누구를 홍보하는지 모르겠다’며 자신을 정면 겨냥하자 지난 15일 재단 상임이사 자리를 내려놓았다.)

Earlier, on the 12th, Gwak had criticized the foundation during a live broadcast on his YouTube channel, noting that most of the foundation’s YouTube videos feature Yoo or individuals associated with him. He argued, "The foundation should produce content aligned with its founding purpose; creating different content could become problematic." (곽상언 의원은 앞서 지난 12일 자신의 유튜브 채널 라이브 방송을 통해 노무현재단 유튜브 영상의 대부분이 유 작가 및 그와 관련된 이들의 영상이라며 “재단의 설립 취지에 맞는 결과물을 만들어야지, 다른 결과물을 만들었기 때문에 문제가 될 수 있다”고 비판했다.)

In a letter to foundation members, Yoo stated, "I plan to step away from the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation for the time being," adding that this was "to prevent any difficulties the foundation might face due to my future critical activities." He concluded with a plea, "Please take good care of the foundation until we meet again." Yoo served as the foundation’s chairman from 2018 to 2021 and recently held an advisory role, hosting a book review segment called "Allileobooks" on the foundation’s YouTube channel. (유 작가는 후원회원들에게 “저는 당분간 노무현재단을 떠나서 살려고 한다”며 이는 “앞으로 제가 할 비평 활동 때문에 노무현재단이 혹시 겪게 될지도 모를 어려움을 예방하기 위해서”라는 사퇴 이유 서신을 남겼다. 그는 “다시 만나는 날까지 재단을 잘 지켜달라”는 당부의 말을 덧붙였다. 유 작가는 2018∼2021년 노무현 재단이사장을 맡았으며, 최근엔 상임고문직을 맡으며 노무현재단 유튜브에서 ‘알릴레오북스’라는 책 소개 코너를 진행해 왔다.)

During the June 3 by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul district in Gyeonggi Province, Yoo supported Cho, saying, "It might be better to have Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party elected than Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party." (유 작가는 6·3 국회의원 경기평택을 재선거 당시 “민주당 김용남보다는 조국혁신당 조국 후보 당선이 좀 낫지 않을까 싶다”고 하며 조 전 대표를 뒷받침했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Unprecedented Boom, Normalizing Holding Taxes"... People Power Party: "Are You Living in a Different World? The People's Livelihoods Are Crying Out" (김용범 “역대급 호황, 보유세 정상화”…국힘 “다른 세상 사나, 민생은 비명”)
item.description:
On the 20th, the People Power Party (PPP) criticized Kim Yong-beom, the head of the Presidential Office’s policy coordination unit, for evaluating South Korea’s economic situation as an "unprecedented boom" and mentioning the need to review the normalization of real estate taxation and the utilization of tax revenue for future industries, calling it "a step beyond deceiving the people to insulting them." (국민의힘은 20일 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 한국 경제 상황을 ‘역대급 호황’이라 평가하면서 부동산 과세 정상화와 미래 산업을 위한 세수 활용 방안을 검토할 필요가 있다고 한 것에 대해 “국민 기만을 넘어 모욕”이라고 비판했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon stated in a commentary, "At this point, it goes beyond a disconnect from reality; it can only be seen as living in a different world." He criticized, "While ignoring the collapsed grassroots economy and the cries of the people's livelihoods, bringing out a few numbers that the public cannot feel and shouting 'unprecedented boom' is not economic analysis but a distortion of reality." He added, "A boom theory that the public cannot feel is just an empty self-praise." (박성훈 수석대변인은 논평에서 “이 정도면 현실과의 괴리를 넘어 다른 세상에 살고 있다고밖에 볼 수 없다”며 “무너진 바닥 경기와 민생의 비명은 외면한 채 국민이 체감하지 못하는 숫자 몇 개를 들고 와 ‘역대급 호황’을 외치는 것은 경제 분석이 아니라 현실 왜곡”이라면서 “국민이 체감하지 못하는 호황론은 공허한 자화자찬일 뿐”이라고 꼬집었다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park further questioned, "What is more serious is that Director Kim has once again mentioned 'adjusting holding taxes and capital gains taxes,' targeting the real estate market with the blade of taxes and regulations." He pressed, "Is the arrogance of the presidential office, intoxicated by statistical illusions, whitewashing the devastation of people's livelihoods as an 'unprecedented boom' while plotting another tax bomb?" (박 수석대변인은 “더욱 심각한 것은 김 실장이 또다시 '보유세·양도세 조정'을 언급하며 부동산 시장에 세금과 규제의 칼날을 겨누고 있다는 점”이라며 “지표 착시에 취한 청와대의 오만이 민생 파탄을 '역대급 호황'으로 분칠하며 또 세금 폭탄을 궁리하느냐”고 따졌다.)

Floor Leader of the PPP, Choi Eun-seok, also issued a commentary stating, "Director Kim has listed various statistics, but the conclusion is clear." He pointed out, "It’s about strengthening holding taxes, strengthening capital gains taxes, and realizing the 'national dividend' plan that has sparked controversy as a socialist idea." Floor Leader Choi said, "This article has once again confirmed that the 'national dividend' plan, criticized for evoking a socialist state-run economy, is not just a personal fantasy but is still alive and moving within the policy line inside the presidential office." He urged, "I hope the government remembers that its job is not to engage in anti-market experiments of artificially redistributing outcomes, but to create an environment where more investment, innovation, and more jobs are generated." (최은석 원내수석대변인도 논평을 내 “김 실장이 여러 통계를 나열했지만 결론은 명확하다”며 “보유세 강화, 양도세 강화, 그리고 사회주의적 발상이라는 논란을 불러왔던 ‘국민 배당금’ 구상을 현실화하겠다는 것”이라고 지적했다. 최 원내수석대변인은 “이번 글로 사회주의 국영 경제를 연상시킨다는 비판을 받았던 ‘국민 배당금’ 구상이 단순한 개인의 공상이 아니라, 여전히 청와대 정책라인 내부에서 살아 움직이고 있다는 사실이 다시 한번 확인됐다”고 말했다. 이어 “정부가 해야 할 일은 성과를 작위적으로 재분배하는 반시장주의적 실험이 아니라 더 많은 투자와 혁신, 더 많은 일자리가 만들어지는 환경을 조성하는 것임을 명심하기 바란다”고 촉구했다.)

Senior Correspondent Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: On 'Ha Jung-woo's Return to the Blue House' Claims, "Disregarding Public Sentiment, the Height of Arrogance" (국힘, ‘하정우 청와대 복귀설’에 “민심 무시, 오만의 극치”)
item.description:
The People Power Party criticized on the 20th the mention of former Blue House senior secretary for artificial intelligence (AI) future strategy, Ha Jung-woo, as a candidate for the full-time vice-chairman of the presidential National AI Strategy Committee, calling it "a Lee Jae-myung-style revolving-door cronyism that neutralizes the people's judgment" and "a blatant disregard for public sentiment and an insult to the nation." (국민의힘은 20일 대통령 직속 국가AI전략위원회 상근 부위원장에 하정우 전 청와대 인공지능(AI)미래기획수석이 거론되는 것과 관련해, “국민의 심판도 무력화시키는 이재명식 측근 돌려막기”라며 “민심에 대한 노골적 무시이자 국민 모독”이라고 비판했다.)

Senior party spokesperson Park Seong-hoon stated in a commentary that day, "Attempting to reinstate former Senior Secretary Ha, who ran as the Democratic Party candidate in the Busan North Gap by-election and failed to receive the people's choice, as the full-time vice-chairman of a presidential strategy committee just over 15 days later is a blatant disregard for public sentiment and the height of arrogance." (박성훈 당 수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “부산 북갑 보궐선거에 민주당 후보로 출마했다가 국민의 선택을 받지 못한 하 전 수석을 불과 보름여 만에 대통령 직속 전략위 상근 부위원장으로 복귀시키려는 것은 민심에 대한 노골적인 무시이자 오만의 극치”라고 밝혔다.)

Senior spokesperson Park also said, "The very idea of placing someone who failed to receive the people's choice back into a key presidential post as if nothing happened is shocking. If this means allocating positions solely based on the president's will while ignoring the people's judgment, it is a challenge to the spirit of democracy." (박 수석대변인은 “국민의 선택을 받지 못한 인사를 아무 일도 없었다는 듯 다시 대통령 직속 핵심 요직에 앉히겠다는 발상 자체가 충격적”이라며 “국민의 판단은 무시한 채 대통령의 의중만으로 자리를 배분하겠다는 것이라면 이는 민주주의 정신에 대한 도전”이라고도 했다.)

Senior spokesperson Park further criticized, "It sends the wrong message to the public service that as long as you are close to the president, another position is guaranteed even after losing an election. What becomes evident with each turn of the revolving door is not the excellence of appointments but the arrogance of the administration and the depleted talent pool of this regime." He argued, "A power that prioritizes cronies over the people's will and values loyalty over public sentiment cannot last long. Withdraw these revolving-door appointments that treat the people with contempt." (박 수석대변인은 “선거에 낙선해도 대통령과 가깝기만 하면 또 다른 자리가 보장된다는 잘못된 메시지를 공직 사회에 보내고 있는 것”이라며 “회전문이 돌 수록 드러나는 것은 인사의 탁월함이 아니라 정권의 오만함이며, 인재풀이 고갈된 정권의 민낯”이라고 꼬집었다. 그는 “국민의 뜻보다 측근을 우선하고 민심보다 충성을 중시하는 권력은 결코 오래갈 수 없다”며 “국민을 우습게 아는 회전문 인사를 철회하라”고 주장했다.)

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Noh Tae-ak Received First Report of Ballot Shortage Only 40 Minutes Before Polls Closed (노태악, 투표종료 40분 전에야 용지부족 첫 보고 받았다)
item.description:
It has been confirmed that former National Election Commission (NEC) Chair Noh Tae-ak received the first report of the ballot shortage crisis on June 3, the day of the local elections, only 40 minutes before polls closed. (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 6·3 지방선거 당일 투표 종료 40분 전에야 투표용지 부족 사태에 관한 첫 보고를 받은 것으로 확인됐다.)

According to data submitted by Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Geon-young on the 20th, obtained from the NEC, former Chair Noh received a verbal report from the NEC spokesperson around 5:20 p.m. on June 3. This was 40 minutes before the main voting ended and five hours and 40 minutes after the Songpa-gu Election Commission had identified the potential ballot shortage. Former Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon and Deputy Secretary-General Kang Dong-wan, who were the operational heads, also received verbal reports from NEC public relations staff around the same time. (20일 윤건영 더불어민주당 의원이 중앙선거관리위원회로부터 제출받은 자료에 따르면, 노 전 위원장은 6월3일 오후 5시20분쯤 중앙선거관리위 대변인의 구두 보고를 받은 것으로 드러났다. 본투표가 종료되기 40분 전이었고, 송파구 선관위가 투표용지 부족 가능성을 파악한 지 5시간40분이 지난 시점이었다. 실무 책임자인 허철훈 전 사무총장과 강동완 사무차장 또한 비슷한 시각에 중앙선관위 공보과 직원들로부터 구두 보고를 받은 것으로 나타났다.)

Earlier, the NEC stated that it had first become aware of the situation through media reports at 5:08 p.m. on the day of the main voting. However, it turned out that the NEC election situation room had received a complaint call around 4:25 p.m. about a ballot shortage at the 3rd polling station in Garak 2-dong. Despite being aware of the chaos on the ground, there was no immediate reporting to superiors or response. (앞서 중앙선거관리위는 본투표 당일 오후 5시8분에 언론보도를 통해 사태를 최초 인지했다고 밝힌 바 있다. 하지만 중앙선거관리위 선거상황실은 오후 4시25분쯤 가락2동 제3투표소에서 투표용지가 부족하다는 민원 전화를 받았던 것으로 나타났다. 현장의 혼란을 인지하고도 즉각적인 상부 보고와 대응이 이뤄지지 않은 것이다.)

In response, lawmaker Yoon Geon-young stated, “The fact that the NEC failed to report the exact situation to senior officials for nearly an hour after first detecting the crisis shows that this incident is a man-made disaster,” adding, “We plan to thoroughly investigate the NEC’s overall incompetence and negligence through a parliamentary audit.” (이와 관련해, 윤건영 의원은 “중앙선관위가 최초 사태를 인지하고 한 시간이 다 되도록 고위직에 정확한 상황조차 보고하지 않았다는 것은 이번 사태가 ‘인재’임을 보여주는 단적인 증거”라며 “선관위의 총체적 부실과 무능에 대해 국정조사를 통해 철저히 파헤칠 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Representative Jeong Cheong-rae Is Too Distant, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok Is Too Close (정청래 대표는 너무 멀고 김민석 총리는 너무 가깝다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung has an excellent survival instinct. He senses crises in advance and thrashes about to escape them by any means. His autobiographical essay, "Lee Jae-myung Will Do It," published when he challenged the Democratic Party's presidential primary in 2017, begins like this. (이재명 대통령은 생존 본능이 뛰어납니다. 위기를 미리 감지하고 몸부림쳐서 어떻게든 빠져나갑니다. 2017년 민주당 대선후보 경선에 도전하면서 출판한 자전적 에세이 ‘이재명은 합니다’는 이렇게 시작합니다.)

"I am not afraid. I don't even blink at most things in life. Not because I was born with a strong heart, but because I have crawled my way up from the very bottom of life." (“나는 겁이 없다. 살아가면서 어지간한 일에는 눈도 깜빡하지 않는다. 날 때부터 강심장이어서가 아니라 인생의 밑바닥에서부터 기어 올라왔기 때문이다.”)

"When I was young, I once fell into a deep puddle while playing in a stream. No matter how much I struggled, my body only sank deeper. The more afraid I became, the higher the chance of dying. Then I remembered what the adults had told me. 'Hold your breath, go down to the bottom, and push off.' That's how I barely got out of the water. Looking back now, I think I've lived my life that way too." (“어릴 때 냇가에서 놀다가 깊은 웅덩이에 빠진 적이 있었다. 아무리 발버둥 쳐도 몸은 점점 가라앉기만 했다. 겁을 먹으면 먹을수록 죽을 확률이 높아지는 상황이었다. 그때 어른들이 해준 이야기가 생각났다. ‘숨을 참고 바닥까지 내려가서 치고 올라와라.’ 나는 그렇게 해서 간신히 물 밖으로 나왔다. 지금 돌이켜보면 인생도 그런 식으로 살아낸 것 같다.”)

In the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, after President Lee Jae-myung's 'pick,' candidate Jeong Won-oh, lost to Mayor Oh Se-hoon, President Lee's unique survival instinct seemed to kick in. Five days after the election, at his first-year anniversary press conference, he lowered his stance significantly, saying, "The election results are a warning from the people to me." Even during his European tour, he posted about domestic political issues in succession. (6·3 서울시장 선거에서 ‘명픽’ 정원오 후보가 오세훈 시장에게 패배하자 이재명 대통령 특유의 생존 본능이 작동한 것 같습니다. 선거 닷새 뒤 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “선거 결과는 국민이 제게 준 경고”라고 몸을 바짝 낮췄습니다. 유럽 순방 중에도 국내 정치 현안에 관한 글을 잇달아 올렸습니다.)

On June 19, when explaining the results of his tour, he also spoke at length about domestic politics. A reporter asked about the 'Lee-Cheon conflict' (between President Lee and party leadership). He answered as follows. (6월19일 순방 결과를 설명할 때도 국내 정치에 대해 많은 말을 했습니다. 기자가 ‘명청 갈등’을 물었습니다. 이렇게 답변했습니다.)

"The relationship between the party and the presidential office is both one and separate. Naturally, we can encourage each other to do well and also point out problems. Although the Democratic Party and the government seem to have immense conflict, I believe it is a process to become better." (“당청 관계는 하나이면서 남이기도 하다. 당연히 서로에게 잘하자고 격려할 수 있고 지적할 수도 있다. 민주당과 정부는 엄청난 갈등이 있는 것처럼 보이지만 더 잘 되기 위한 과정이라고 생각한다.”)

A reporter asked about the cause of the decline in approval ratings. He answered as follows. (기자가 지지율 하락의 원인을 물었습니다. 이렇게 답변했습니다.)

"There may be various analyses, but the biggest one is, 'We're dying because it's hard to make a living, and what are you fighting over? What does your squabble have to do with our lives and the public duties we entrusted to you?'" (“여러 분석이 있겠지만 제일 큰 건 ‘먹고 살기 힘들어 죽겠는데 뭘 가지고 싸우는 거냐, 도대체 너희 다툼이라는 게 우리 삶과 뭔 상관이고 우리가 맡긴 공적 업무랑 무슨 상관이냐’는 것이다.”)

It seems President Lee Jae-myung's perception is that 'the party-presidential office conflict is not a major issue, and the drop in approval ratings is due to internal conflict within the Democratic Party.' However, the recent simultaneous decline in both President Lee Jae-myung's approval ratings and the Democratic Party's support should be seen as a phenomenon arising from the intertwined Lee-Cheon conflict and the power struggle for the next leadership between Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. (‘당청 갈등은 큰 문제가 없고, 지지율이 떨어지는 것은 민주당 내부 갈등 때문’이라는 게 이재명 대통령의 인식인 것 같습니다. 그러나 최근 이재명 대통령 지지율과 민주당 지지도 동반 하락은 명청갈등, 그리고 정청래 대표와 김민석 국무총리의 차기 권력 투쟁이 얽히고설켜 나타나는 현상이라고 봐야 합니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung is plainly, to any observer, restraining Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and backing Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. Representative Jeong Cheong-rae rebelled against President Lee over the issue of supplementary prosecution powers for the prosecution. At the welcome ceremony upon Lee's return, he bowed 90 degrees with a folding greeting, and sparked controversy for sycophancy and self-praise by saying things like "the Republic of Korea is a Lee Jae-myung holding country" or "(the stock index reaching 9000 is) thanks to President Lee Jae-myung's excellent crisis management skills." (이재명 대통령은 누가 봐도 확실하게 정청래 대표를 견제하고 김민석 총리를 밀어주고 있습니다. 정청래 대표는 검찰 보완수사권 문제로 이재명 대통령에게 반기를 들었습니다. 귀국 환영장에서 90도로 머리를 숙이는 폴더 인사를 했고, “대한민국은 이재명 보유국”이라거나 “(주가 9000은) 이재명 대통령의 탁월한 위기관리 능력 덕분”이라고 말해 과공비례, 자화자찬 논란을 빚었습니다.)

What is wrong? What should the desirable relationship between the president and the ruling party be? The party-presidential office relationship President Lee mentioned is, strictly speaking, the party-government relationship. It is worth examining history. (뭐가 잘못된 것일까요? 대통령과 여당의 바람직한 관계는 어떤 것일까요? 이재명 대통령이 말한 당청 관계는 정확히 말하면 당정 관계입니다. 역사를 살펴볼 필요가 있습니다.)

During the dictatorship and authoritarian era, the party and government were one body. The ruling party was the president's governing apparatus. President Syngman Rhee was the chairman of the Liberal Party, President Park Chung-hee was the chairman of the Democratic Republican Party. President Chun Doo-hwan was the chairman of the Democratic Justice Party, President Roh Tae-woo was the chairman of the Democratic Justice Party and later the Democratic Liberal Party. President Kim Young-sam was the chairman of the Democratic Liberal Party and the New Korea Party, President Kim Dae-jung was the chairman of the National Congress for New Politics and the Millennium Democratic Party. (독재 및 권위주의 시절 당정은 한 몸이었습니다. 여당은 대통령의 통치 기구였습니다. 이승만 대통령은 자유당 총재, 박정희 대통령은 공화당 총재였습니다. 전두환 대통령은 민정당 총재, 노태우 대통령은 민정당 민자당 총재였습니다. 김영삼 대통령은 민자당 신한국당 총재, 김대중 대통령은 새정치국민회의 새천년민주당 총재였습니다.)

The president was an imperial chairman. He was the owner of the party. He controlled nominations and political funds. When public sentiment soured, they conducted a 'party-government reshuffle.' Except for the floor leader elected by lawmakers, all party positions were appointed by the chairman. In those days, questions like this appeared in current affairs quizzes. Try to answer it. (대통령은 제왕적 총재였습니다. 정당의 주인이었습니다. 공천과 정치자금을 좌지우지했습니다. 민심이 악화하면 ‘당정개편’이라는 것을 했습니다. 의원들이 선출하는 원내총무를 제외하고 모든 당직자는 총재가 임명했습니다. 그 시절 시사 상식으로 이런 문제가 출제됐습니다. 맞춰보시기 바랍니다.)

Question: Which of the following is NOT one of the 'Three Top Party Positions'? 1) Chairman 2) Secretary-General 3) Floor Leader 4) Policy Committee Chairman (문제 : 다음 중 ‘당 3역’이 아닌 것은? 1) 총재 2) 사무총장 3) 원내총무 4) 정책위의장)

The correct answer is 1) Chairman. The chairman was a transcendent figure reigning over the three top party positions. (정답은 1번 총재입니다. 총재는 당 3역 위에 군림하는 초월적 존재였습니다.)

Change began with President Roh Moo-hyun. President Roh was a member of the Millennium Democratic Party and the Uri Party but did not become its chairman. It was party-government separation. It failed. In the "60-Year History of the Democratic Party" published in 2016, there is this passage. (변화가 생긴 것은 노무현 대통령부터입니다. 노무현 대통령은 새천년민주당 열린우리당 당원이었지만 총재를 하지 않았습니다. 당정분리였습니다. 실패했습니다. 2016년 출판한 ‘더불어민주당 60년사’에 이런 대목이 있습니다.)

"Attempts at decentralization and party democratization through party-government separation remained incomplete." (“당정분리를 통한 분권, 정당 민주화 시도는 미완에 그쳤다.”)

"President Roh did not try to seize control of the party. Rather, he kept a certain distance. He parted ways with the chairmanship that had dominated the party from an imperial position in the past. It reflected President Roh's intention to reject authoritarianism. It was certainly a meaningful decision and a reformative political experiment. Through party-government separation, President Roh sought to grant autonomy to the party and the National Assembly." (“노 대통령은 당을 장악하려 하지 않았다. 오히려 일정한 거리를 두었다. 과거 제왕적 위치에서 당을 지배했던 총재직과 결별했다. 권위주의를 배격하려는 노 대통령의 의중이 반영된 것이었다. 분명 의미 있는 결단이었고 개혁적인 정치실험이었다. 노 대통령은 당정분리를 통해 정당과 의회에 자율권을 주고자 했다.”)

"However, problems arose as the vertical party-government relationship was shifted to a horizontal one. Neither the government nor the party was prepared. Was it perhaps a transitional limitation and conflict revealed in the process of overcoming the political practices and culture centered on the imperial chairman or president and moving toward party reform? The side effects revealed were too severe to accept as mere trial and error for establishing a new system." (“하지만 수직적 당정관계를 수평적으로 이동하다 보니 문제가 생겼다. 정부나 당 모두 준비가 되어 있지 않았다. 제왕적 총재나 대통령 중심의 정치 관행과 문화가 해소되고 정당개혁으로 가는 과정에서 드러난 과도기적 한계와 갈등이었을까. 새로운 제도의 착근을 위한 시행착오로 받아들이기엔 드러난 부작용도 심각했다.”)

The ambiguous relationship between the president and the ruling party was the same under President Moon Jae-in as it is under President Lee Jae-myung. Setting aside practices and culture, what do the regulations say? Chapter 13 of the Democratic Party's constitution is titled 'Relationship between the Party and the President'. (대통령과 여당의 어정쩡한 관계는 문재인 대통령 때도 이재명 대통령 때도 마찬가지였습니다. 관행과 문화는 그렇다고 치고, 규정은 어떻게 되어 있을까요? 민주당 당헌 13장은 ‘당과 대통령의 관계’입니다.)

"A party member elected as president cannot concurrently hold any party position other than an honorary one during their term." (“대통령에 당선된 당원은 그 재임기간 동안 명예직 이외의 당직을 겸임할 수 없다.”)

"A party member elected as president holds the authority to participate in determining party policy and the duty to implement party policy during their term." (“대통령에 당선된 당원은 그 재임기간 동안 당론 결정에 참여할 권한과 당론을 이행할 의무를 가진다.”)

The passage stating 'the president holds the authority to participate in determining party policy' is very striking. Many may believe the president should not intervene in party affairs, but the Democratic Party's constitution actually clearly grants the president the authority to participate in party policy decisions. Based on this clause, it is possible that President Lee Jae-myung will send messages opposing Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's re-election and supporting Representative Kim Min-seok much more explicitly in the future. (‘대통령이 당론 결정에 참여할 권한을 갖는다’는 대목이 무척 인상적입니다. 대통령이 당무에 개입하면 안 된다고 알고 있는 사람이 많겠지만, 민주당 당헌은 오히려 대통령이 당론 결정에 참여할 수 있는 권한을 확실하게 부여하고 있는 것입니다. 이 조항을 근거로 앞으로 이재명 대통령이 지금보다 훨씬 더 노골적으로 정청래 대표 연임에 반대하고 김민석 대표를 지지한다는 메시지를 낼 수도 있다고 봅니다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party's constitution includes clauses stating, "The president's intervention in major party affairs such as internal elections, nominations, and personnel appointments is prohibited," and "Actions by a specific individual, including the president, or a specific faction becoming central or taking the lead that undermine intra-party democracy, members' autonomy, and autonomous competition are not permitted." These were new clauses created in May 2025 to fundamentally block presidential intervention in party affairs, which caused major problems during President Yoon Suk-yeol's tenure. (반면 국민의힘 당헌에는 “당내 선거 및 공천, 인사 등 주요 당무에 관하여 대통령의 개입을 금지한다”, “대통령을 포함하여 특정인이 중심이 되거나 또는 특정 세력이 주축이 되어 당내 민주주의와 당원의 자율성 및 자율 경쟁을 훼손하는 행위는 허용하지 아니한다”는 조항이 있습니다. 윤석열 대통령 시절 큰 문제를 일으킨 대통령의 당무 개입을 원천적으로 차단하려고 2025년 5월 새로 만든 조항입니다.)

How will the Lee-Cheon conflict and the next leadership power struggle between Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok unfold? Representative Jeong Cheong-rae visited Jeonju Nambu Market on June 19 to express gratitude for the local elections. Prime Minister Kim Min-seok also held a meeting with university students from the Jeonbuk region and Hyundai Motor officials at Saemangeum on the same day. Despite concerns inside and outside the party, both appear competitively immersed in the power struggle. (명청 갈등과 정청래-김민석의 차기 권력 투쟁은 앞으로 어떻게 전개될까요? 정청래 대표는 6월19일 전주 남부시장을 방문해 지방선거 감사 인사를 했습니다. 김민석 총리도 같은 날 새만금에서 전북 지역 대학생 및 현대차 관계자들과 간담회를 했습니다. 당 안팎의 우려에 아랑곳하지 않고 두 사람 모두 경쟁적으로 권력 투쟁에 몰두하는 모양새입니다.)

Will Representative Jeong Cheong-rae actually challenge for re-election? It depends on his choice. However, if Representative Jeong Cheong-rae runs, the conflict with President Lee Jae-myung seems likely to become much more serious than it is now. (정청래 대표가 과연 연임에 도전할까요? 정청래 대표의 선택에 달렸습니다. 그러나 정청래 대표가 출마하면 이재명 대통령과의 갈등은 지금보다 훨씬 더 심각해질 것 같습니다.)

Division among Democratic Party members and supporters is inevitable. Members and supporters are already split into two factions, brawling. Some zealous members and supporters do not hesitate to hurl insults and 'dig graves' (a reference to a Korean movie and idiom about extreme conflict) at opponents. The level of danger has already been exceeded. If this situation continues until the all-member party convention on August 17, the Democratic Party could be ruined. Even if Representative Jeong Cheong-rae succeeds in being re-elected, can he properly perform his duties as leader? (민주당 당원과 지지층의 분열은 불가피합니다. 당원과 지지자들은 벌써 두 패로 갈려 이전투구를 벌이고 있습니다. 일부 열성 당원과 지지자들은 상대를 향해 욕설과 ‘파묘’를 서슴지 않습니다. 위험 수위를 이미 넘어섰습니다. 8월17일 전 당원대회까지 이런 상황이 계속되면 민주당이 망할 수도 있습니다. 정청래 대표가 연임에 성공한들 대표직을 제대로 수행할 수 있을까요?)

Would everything go well if Prime Minister Kim Min-seok becomes the Democratic Party leader? That also seems unlikely. There are two problems. (김민석 총리가 민주당 대표가 되면 모든 일이 잘될까요? 그렇지도 않을 것 같습니다. 두 가지 문제가 있습니다.)

First, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's base within the party is surprisingly weak. He ran for party leader at the August 28, 2022 national convention but was cut off, pushed aside by candidates Kang Hoon-sik, Park Yong-jin, and Lee Jae-myung. He ran for Supreme Council member at the August 18, 2024 national convention, struggling initially before winning first place thanks to overwhelming support from then-leader Lee Jae-myung. It is difficult to say he has solid support from party members now either. (첫째, 김민석 총리는 의외로 당내 기반이 허약합니다. 2022년 8·28 전당대회에 대표로 출마했다가 강훈식 박용진 이재명 후보에게 밀려 컷오프된 일이 있습니다. 2024년 8·18 전국당원대회에는 최고위원으로 출마했는데, 초반에는 고전하다가 이재명 대표의 전폭적인 지원 덕분에 1위를 차지했습니다. 지금도 당원들의 확고한 지지세가 있다고 보기 어렵습니다.)

It is true that a majority of Democratic Party lawmakers support Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. However, this is said to be because lawmakers know where President Lee Jae-myung's will lies. Also because they dislike Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. (민주당 의원들은 다수가 김민석 총리를 지지하는 것은 사실입니다. 하지만 그건 이재명 대통령의 뜻이 어디에 있는지 의원들이 알기 때문이라고 합니다. 또 정청래 대표를 싫어하기 때문이라고 합니다.)

Second, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is too close to President Lee Jae-myung. If Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's problem is being too distant, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's problem is being too close. The ruling party leader also has a responsibility to stop the president's high-handedness and unilateral actions. (둘째, 김민석 총리는 이재명 대통령과 지나치게 가깝습니다. 정청래 대표가 너무 멀어서 문제라면 김민석 총리는 너무 가까워서 문제입니다. 여당 대표에게는 대통령의 전횡과 독주를 저지해야 하는 책무도 있습니다.)

During President Yoon Suk-yeol's time, lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun, elected leader of the People Power Party in March 2023 with President Yoon's full support, re-nominated former Gangseo District Mayor Kim Tae-woo according to President Yoon's will in the October 11 by-election, lost, and stepped down from the leadership in December. This left a lesson: without the grit and courage to stand up to the president, it is difficult to perform the role of ruling party leader. This is a case Prime Minister Kim Min-seok should take to heart. Lessons from negative examples are not far away. (윤석열 대통령 시절 김기현 의원은 윤석열 대통령의 전폭적인 지원을 받아 2023년 3월 국민의힘 대표로 선출됐지만 10·11 강서구청장 보궐선거에서 윤석열 대통령의 뜻에 따라 김태우 전 구청장을 재공천했다가 패배하고 12월에 대표직에서 물러났습니다. 대통령에게 맞설 수 있는 강단과 용기가 없으면 여당 대표직을 수행하기 어렵다는 교훈을 남겼습니다. 김민석 총리가 새겨야 할 사례입니다. 반면교사는 그리 멀리 있지 않습니다.)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok faces the difficult task of breaking away from being 'Lee Jae-myung's pick' and expanding his support base to the Democratic Party's traditional supporters. It is difficult to become leader with only the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction, whose substance is unclear, and even if he becomes leader, it will be difficult to properly steer the party. Is Prime Minister Kim Min-seok capable of doing this? What do you think? item.title: Cho Kuk: "Democratic Party, Answer the Call... Why They Rejected Unification in Pyeongtaek B and Suspended Merger" (조국 “민주당 응답하라…평택을 단일화 거부·합당 중단 이유”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, demanded an explanation on the 21st regarding the situation during the Pyeongtaek B by-election for the National Assembly, which was held alongside the June 3 local elections. He claimed the Democratic Party of Korea rejected unification and declared no merger would take place. (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 21일 지난 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 더불어민주당이 단일화를 거부하고, 합당도 없다고 선언했다며 당시 상황에 대한 해명을 요구했다.)

The former leader posted a piece titled '10 Questions the Democratic Party Must Answer Regarding the Pyeongtaek B By-election' on his Facebook page that day. (조 전 대표는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 ‘평택을 재선거와 관련하여 민주당이 답해야 할 10가지 질문’이라는 글을 올렸다.)

The post by the former leader included an evaluation of the results of the Pyeongtaek B election, along with inquiries such as: why the Democratic Party nominated a candidate for the Pyeongtaek B election, despite its policy of not running candidates in regions where it bore responsibility for past issues; the background behind candidate Kim Yong-nam’s rejection of the demand for unification; strategic directions regarding unification for the 2028 general election; and the current political status of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party as assessed by the Democratic Party. (조 전 대표가 올린 글을 보면 지난 평택을 선거 결과에 대한 평가와 함께 △민주당의 귀책사유 지역 무공천 방침과 달리 공천을 한 이유 △단일화 요구에도 김용남 후보가 이를 거부한 배경 △2028년 총선에서 단일화와 관련한 전략 방향 △현재 민주당이 판단하는 조국혁신당에 대한 정치적 위상 등을 묻고 있다.)

Below is the full text of the questions raised by the former leader. (다음은 조 전 대표가 제시한 질문 전문이다.)

<10 Questions the Democratic Party Must Answer Regarding the Pyeongtaek B By-election> (<평택을 재선거와 관련하여 민주당이 답해야 할 10가지 질문>)

1. Unlike past instances where the Democratic Party did not nominate candidates in regions where it bore responsibility, why did it nominate a candidate this time? (1. 과거 민주당 귀책사유 지역에 무공천 했던 것과 달리, 이번에는 왜 공천했는가?)

2. Why did candidate Kim Yong-nam (28.77%) receive far less support compared to the Democratic Party’s Pyeongtaek mayoral winner, Choi Won-yong (59.76%), and the Democratic Party’s proportional representation vote share in Pyeongtaek City (50.9%)? (2. 김용남 후보(28.77%)는 평택 시장 당선자 민주당 최원용 후보 득표율(59.76%), 민주당 평택시 비례 득표율(50.9%)에 비해서 왜 훨씬 적은 지지를 받았나?)

3. Why did Cho Kuk (27.24%) receive far more support than the Cho Kuk Innovation Party’s proportional representation vote share in Pyeongtaek City (7.59%)? (3. 조국 후보(27.24%)는 조국혁신당 평택시 비례득표율(7.59%)보다 왜 훨씬 많은 지지를 받았나?)

4. Why did about half of Democratic Party supporters vote for Cho Kuk? (4. 민주당 지지자들의 절반 정도는 왜 조국 후보에게 투표했는가?)

5. If multiple media reports had revealed suspicions that Cho Kuk, in the same way as Kim Yong-nam, effectively owned a loan shark company and operated it through a representative, would the Democratic Party and Kim Yong-nam have refrained from criticizing it entirely? (5. 조국 후보가 김용남 후보와 똑같은 방식으로 대부업체를 사실상 소유하고 대리인을 통하여 운영하고 있었다는 의혹이 여러 언론 보도를 통해 드러났다면, 민주당과 김용남 후보는 이를 전혀 비판하지 않았을 것인가?)

6. Cho Kuk maintained a stance during the election period that 'unification' was necessary. Why did the Democratic Party and Kim Yong-nam flatly reject it? (6. 조국 후보는 선거 기간중 '단일화' 필요하다는 입장을 견지했는데, 민주당과 김용남 후보는 왜 단호히 거부했는가?)

7. Did the Democratic Party underestimate the 'Shy Yoo Ui-dong' factor in its own internal polls and conclude it would win without unification? (7. 당 자체 여론조사에서 ‘샤이 유의동’을 간과하고 단일화 없이도 이긴다고 판단한 것이 아닌가?)

8. Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won continuously demanded that Cho Kuk drop out during the election period. For the Democratic Party, was the only form of unification one achieved through 'the Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate’s withdrawal'? (8. 민주당 박지원 의원은 선거 기간 내내 조국 후보 사퇴를 요구했는데, 민주당이 생각하는 단일화는 '조국혁신당 후보 사퇴를 통한 단일화'일 뿐인가?)

9. Will the Democratic Party also adopt a strategy in the 2028 general election that pressures only the Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate to withdraw? (9. 민주당은 28년 총선에서도 조국혁신당 후보에게만 사퇴를 강박하는 전략을 취할 것인가?)

10. Before the June 3 elections, the Democratic Party proposed a merger but suspended it due to internal disagreements. During the June 3 election period, it rejected unification and declared no merger. Is the Cho Kuk Innovation Party now merely a necessary presence for the Democratic Party to fill numbers in committee and plenary votes? (10. 민주당은 6.3 선거 전 합당을 제안하였으나 내부 이견으로 합당을 중단했고, 6.3 선거 기간 중에는 단일화도 거부했고 합당도 없다고 선언했다. 이제 민주당에게 조국혁신당은 상임위와 본회의 표결 시 숫자 채우기를 위하여 필요한 존재에 불과한가?)

Hah Yeah-young Reporter haha@hani.co.kr (하어영 기자 haha@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking News] Han Chan-sik Named Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, Sung Ki-hong for Public Relations, Kim Kyung-ja for Social Affairs ([속보] 청와대 민정수석에 한찬식, 홍보수석 성기홍, 사회수석 김경자)
item.description:

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "In the final stages of the election, Jang Dong-hyuk showed up in Seoul... I had to put in some effort to avoid him." (오세훈 “선거 막판 장동혁 서울 출몰…그거 피하느라 신경 좀 썼다”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the Mayor of Seoul who secured a fifth term with a victory in the June 3 local elections, said, "There were difficult moments during the (campaign period) when I had to avoid Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk." (6·3 지방선거 승리로 5선 고지에 오른 오세훈 서울시장이 “(유세 기간) 장동혁 대표를 피하느라고 어려운 순간도 있었다”고 말했다.)

The Mayor responded to this on the TV Chosun program "Strong Rivals" on the 20th, when asked, "Among the various factors for your victory, there’s an analysis that the absence of a campaign support visit by Jang Dong-hyuk, the chair of the People Power Party, was key. Do you agree?" (오 시장은 20일 티브이(TV)조선 ‘강적들’에 출연해 ‘여러 승리 요인 가운데 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 지원 유세가 없었던 점이 주효했다는 분석이 있는데 동의하느냐’는 질문에 이같이 답했다.)

Mayor Oh said, "At first, he seemed to know we weren’t welcoming, so he naturally only toured the provinces. But in the last few days of the election, he came up to the capital region," adding, "And then he started showing up in Seoul. I thought clashing with him (Chairman Jang) wouldn’t help with votes, so I began avoiding him." He continued, "In the final day or two (of the election), the party started scheduling events overlapping with mine, so the staff handling my schedule had a tough time avoiding him and had to put in some effort." (오 시장은 “처음에는 우리가 달가워하지 않는다는 걸 알아서 그런지 (장 대표가) 당연히 지방만 돌았는데 선거 마지막 며칠을 남겨놓고는 수도권으로 올라왔다”며 “그러면서 서울에 출몰하기 시작했는데 정말 (장 대표와) 부딪히는 것은 득표에 도움이 안 된다고 생각했기 때문에 피하기 시작했다”고 말했다. 이어 “(선거) 마지막 하루이틀 남겨놓고는 (장 대표와) 내 동선하고 겹치는 일정이 당에서 나오기 시작해서 일정 짜는 친구들이 그거 피해 다니느라고 신경 좀 썼다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the mounting calls within the party for Chairman Jang to step down, Oh said, "Given the tendencies of our party’s National Assembly members, they wouldn’t want a resignation that looks like he’s being chased out in an undignified manner—if only for their own pride," adding, "I think it will take a bit more time (for the resignation)." Earlier, on the 17th, Mayor Oh had stated, "The Jang Dong-hyuk leadership has reached the end of its life." (당에서 장 대표 사퇴 요구가 빗발치는 상황에 대해선 “우리 당 국회의원님들의 성향상 볼썽사납게 쫓겨나는 듯한 모습의 퇴진은 원치 않을 것이다. 본인들의 자존심을 위해서라도”라며 “아마 (사퇴에는) 시간이 좀 더 소요될 것이라고 생각한다”고 말했다. 앞서 오 시장은 지난 17일 “장동혁 지도부는 수명을 다했다”고 말한 바 있다.)

On Na Kyung-won, a People Power Party lawmaker, who said on the 12th, "If I were the (Oh Se-hoon) Seoul Mayor elect, I would have declared a by-election," Oh responded, "I don’t interpret that as an ‘anti’ against me. I see it as a reply directed at the young Seoul citizens at Olympic Park." He added, "On the day she said that, we happened to have a meal together, and she even brought a congratulatory cake." (나경원 국민의힘 의원이 지난 12일 “내가 (오세훈) 서울시장 당선자였다면 재선거를 선언했을 것”이라고 말한 데 대해선 “나에 대한 ‘안티’로 해석하지 않고 올림픽공원에 있는 젊은 서울 시민들에 대한 화답 차원의 말로 생각한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “그렇게 이야기한 날 마침 식사를 같이했는데 축하 케이크도 사 왔다”고 덧붙였다.)

Meanwhile, Mayor Oh revealed that he has contacted the presidential office, requesting a meeting before a cabinet meeting, and is awaiting a response. Oh said, "If I could have just 30 minutes (to talk to President Lee Jae-myung), I’ve asked for an opportunity to explain the issues I see in the housing market, rather than debating during the cabinet meeting," adding, "He said he’d think about it after returning from abroad and get back to me. Now that he’s back, I’m waiting." (한편, 오 시장은 국무회의 전에 자신을 불러달라고 대통령실에 연락하고 답을 기다리고 있다고 밝혔다. 오 시장은 “30분 정도만 (이재명 대통령에게) 이야기할 기회를 주면 굳이 국무회의 들어가서 따지는 게 아니라 내가 생각하는 주택시장의 문제점을 말씀드릴 기회를 달라고 요청을 했다”며 “(이 대통령) 귀국 뒤에 생각해서 연락을 주겠다고 했는데 이제 귀국했으니 기다리고 있다”고 말했다.)

Lee Yu-jin, reporter yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Woo Won-shik: “If We Hold a Party Convention with Mockery and Division, What Will Remain?”… Announces He Will Not Run (우원식 “조롱과 분열로 전당대회 치르면 뭐가 남나”…불출마 선언)
item.description:
Former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik has declared that he will not run in the Democratic Party of Korea’s party convention scheduled for August. Criticizing the internal conflicts arising during the race for party leadership, former Speaker Woo stated, “We must first clarify who the Democratic Party is for and what this party convention is for. Only then can the competition for party leadership hold meaning.” (우원식 전 국회의장이 오는 8월 치러지는 더불어민주당 전당대회 불출마를 선언했다. 우 전 의장은 당권 경쟁 과정에서 불거진 당내 갈등을 비판하며 “민주당이 누구를 위한 정당인지, 이번 전당대회가 무엇을 위한 전당대회인지부터 분명히 해야 한다”며 “그래야 당권 경쟁도 의미를 가질 수 있다”고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 21st titled “Statement by Lawmaker Woo Won-shik on the Democratic Party Convention,” former Speaker Woo wrote, “I have no intention of running in this party convention. Who is the Democratic Party for? What is this party convention for?” (우 전 의장은 21일 페이스북에 ‘민주당 전당대회 관련 우원식 의원 입장문’이라는 글을 올려 저는 이번 전당대회에 나갈 생각이 없다”며 “누구를 위한 민주당인가. 무엇을 위한 전당대회인가”라고 했다.)

Former Speaker Woo said, “Degrading terms that are hard to utter are being mobilized to attack opponents within the party. It is embarrassing and shameful. If we hold a party convention while wounding each other, mocking others, finding faults, and fueling division, what will remain for our party afterward?” (우 전 의장은 “차마 입에 담기 어려운 멸칭들이 내부의 상대를 공격하기 위해 동원되고 있다. 민망하고 부끄럽다”며 “이렇게 서로에게 상처를 내고, 상대를 조롱하고, 흠집을 잡고, 분열을 키우면서 전당대회를 치르고 나면, 그다음에 우리 당에는 무엇이 남는 것인가”라고 했다.)

He continued, “If we fail to properly heed the warning from the people in the last local elections, there is no future (for the Democratic Party). In particular, I ask those seeking to run in the party convention to look as courageously and honestly as possible at the reality our Democratic Party faces, as it is.” (이어 그는 “지난 지방선거에서 국민께 받은 경고, 그 뜻을 제대로 새기지 못하면 (민주당에) 미래는 없다”며 “특히 전당대회에 나서려는 분들은 최대한 용기 있고, 정직하게 우리 민주당이 직면한 현실을 있는 그대로 봐줄 것을 요청한다”고 했다.)

Former Speaker Woo said, “When the Democratic Party splits internally and turns swords against each other, it has invariably shrunk and suffered defeat. Having endured that pain from the past administration, and at a time when we should be expanding the path of democratic governance even more, it hasn’t even been a year, yet we saw division in Pyeongtaek during the local elections, and internal conflicts are so severe that it’s hard to see the way forward.” (우 전 의장은 “민주당은 내부에서 갈라지고 서로를 향해 칼을 겨누었을 때, 어김없이 쪼그라들고 패배했다”며 “지난 정권 그 고통을 겪고 단 1년, 민주정부의 길을 더 확장해도 모자랄 판에 지방선거 때 평택에서 분열하고, 내부도 앞을 내다보기 어려워질 정도로 갈등이 심하다”고 했다.)

Former Speaker Woo said, “This is a plea from someone who has lived a lifetime as a party member of the Democratic Party, walking alongside the underprivileged on the ground. I can no longer bear to watch the party’s division and antagonism. Let us first clarify who the Democratic Party is for and what this party convention is for. Only then can the competition for party leadership hold meaning.” (우 전 의장은 “평생을 민주당의 당인으로, 현장에서 을과 함께 걸어온 사람으로서 당의 분열과 반목을 차마 더는 지켜보기가 힘들어서 드리는 당부”라며 “민주당이 누구를 위한 정당인지, 이 전당대회가 무엇을 위한 전당대회인지부터 분명히 하자. 그래야 당권경쟁도 의미가 있다”고 했다.)
